newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks snap back to end at record.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks snap back to end at record.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks snapped back from a sharp sell-off to close in record territory Monday as the market tracked the recovery in bonds ahead of Tuesday's meeting of the Federal Reserve's interest-rate setting group.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 6.28 points at 5,894.74, which surpassed last Monday's record close of 5,889.20. Early in the day, the index was off more than 50 points due to weakness in bonds.
But in the broader market, declining issues beat advances 14-8 on moderate volume of 298 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
